risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, crisis VIX at 327, rising dollar) combined with critical earnings binary event in 2 days create extreme risk environment for NUE.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI9 rising with AO crossover and supertrend bullish provide short-term momentum entry signal, amplified by extreme fear sentiment (24/10) creating contrarian buy opportunity near support at 114.829.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary in 2 days combined with macro crisis (VIX 327, inverted yield curve, rising dollar) and overbought oscillators (RSI14, Stoch, Williams %R) with weak intermediate trend structure (EMA20/50 bearish, price below Ichimoku cloud) create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
